# Notenix

> Notenix (www.notenix.com) is an online practice-test platform for students worldwide. Students sit timed, exam-style tests with instant marking, and can request full mock tests that are marked by real tutors from Beyond Tutors. All questions are original, written by tutors.

## Exams covered
- [SAT practice](https://www.notenix.com/sat): Digital SAT Math and Reading & Writing practice, type-in and multiple-choice questions, free sample questions.
- [ESAT practice](https://www.notenix.com/esat): Engineering and Science Admissions Test mocks (Maths 1 & 2, Physics, Chemistry, Biology).
- [TMUA practice](https://www.notenix.com/tmua): Test of Mathematics for University Admission, Paper 1 and Paper 2 mocks.
- [GCSE Maths practice](https://www.notenix.com/gcse-maths): AQA, Edexcel and OCR tests with a 9–1 grade estimate.
- [A-Level Maths practice](https://www.notenix.com/a-level-maths): Pure, Statistics and Mechanics tests with an A*–E estimate.
- [IGCSE practice](https://www.notenix.com/igcse): Cambridge and Pearson Edexcel International GCSE.
- [HSC practice](https://www.notenix.com/hsc): NSW HSC Mathematics Advanced, Extension 1 and 2 practice.
- [VCE practice](https://www.notenix.com/vce): Victorian VCE Methods and Specialist, tech-free and CAS-style.
- [QCE practice](https://www.notenix.com/qce): Queensland QCE Methods and Specialist, internal and external assessment.
- [WACE practice](https://www.notenix.com/wace): WA ATAR Methods and Specialist, calculator-free and calculator-assumed.
- [NCEA practice](https://www.notenix.com/ncea): New Zealand NCEA Level 2 Maths and Level 3 Calculus.

## KS3 (Years 7-9) for parents
- [Notenix KS3](https://www.notenix.com/ks3): timed tests in Maths, Science and English for Years 7-9, homework help from Beyond Tutors tutors, KS3 notes and a monthly progress report for parents. Free for one week, then £149 a year.
- [Year 7 notes and practice questions](https://www.notenix.com/ks3/year-7), [Year 8](https://www.notenix.com/ks3/year-8), [Year 9](https://www.notenix.com/ks3/year-9): free topic pages with worked examples and answers.
- [The Year 7 dip](https://www.notenix.com/guides/year-7-dip): why many children slip in their first year of secondary school and how to spot it early.
- [What your child should know by the end of Year 7](https://www.notenix.com/guides/what-your-child-should-know-by-the-end-of-year-7)
- [Questions to ask at a Year 7 parents' evening](https://www.notenix.com/guides/questions-to-ask-at-year-7-parents-evening)
- [Helping with Year 7 maths homework](https://www.notenix.com/guides/help-with-year-7-maths-homework)

## How it works
- [Request a tutor-marked test](https://www.notenix.com/request): a student requests a test, the Notenix team assigns it, the student sits it online, and a tutor marks it with feedback.
- [Pricing](https://www.notenix.com/pricing): free practice; full access is £49 a year for Beyond Tutors students (free during their trial class) and £149 a year for all other students, payable by bank transfer from any country.

## About
- Notenix is a unit of Beyond Groups. Tests are marked by tutors from Beyond Tutors (https://www.thebeyondtutors.com).
- Contact: support@notenix.com
